g.text: 5 V / 15 A into J1. C1 = 1000 uF across
the rail. Inject 5 V and GND at every
one of the 10 LED rows, not just at one
corner minute dots. One daisy chain:
DIN from level shifter HV4, DOUT
through all 224. Data order follows the
D32 = LED data, D21/D22 = I2C to

corner touch pads are not used.
